## About
Jem Service Center has been doing auto diagnostics and repairs for the borough of Middlesex and the surrounding towns for a long time. We work on cars and trucks, foreign and domestic, new or used, and we handle both minor and major repairs.
Our mechanics are ASE certified and keep up with regular training, and the shop runs on up-to-date computer diagnostics. If you have a question about your vehicle or a repair, our front office is happy to talk it through with you.
Customers have given us a 5 star rating across 95 Google reviews. Some of them have been bringing their cars here for years, and we'd be glad to take care of yours too.

## Services
- Computer diagnostics: We track down the problem with up-to-date diagnostic equipment before any work starts.
- N.J. State Inspections and emission repairs: State inspections, plus state licensed emission repairs if your car needs work to pass.
- Wheel alignments: Computer wheel alignments.
- Tires: Tire mounting and balancing.
- Oil, lube and filter changes: Routine oil service to keep your car running well.
- Suspension and drive train: Suspension and drive train repairs.
- Heating and cooling systems: Repairs to your car's heating and cooling systems.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We do diagnostics and repairs on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Can you work on trucks?
A: Yes. We do complete repairs on cars and trucks.

Q: My car is under warranty. Can I still bring it to you?
A: Yes. We will honor your manufacturer or extended warranty.
